post.description: Teaching cards for the new items and refresher cards for earlier items, each placed before an exercise, then 10 to 15 exercises with payloads and accept lists. A session is kept for 24 hours; starting again within that time returns it.

post.description: Re-grades the responses on the server, then records lesson progress and awards XP in one transaction. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first response.

post.summary: Start a unit test-out, or resume the unexpired one
post.description: 20 exercises drawn from the unit's items. Offered for an open unit that is not finished. A session is kept for 24 hours; starting again within that time returns it.

post.summary: Complete a unit test-out
post.description: Re-grades the responses on the server. At 85% or better the unit is finished and earns test-out XP, in one transaction. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first response.

post.summary: Start a review session, or resume the unexpired one
post.description: Up to 20 due items, oldest due first, with one exercise per due facet. A session is kept for 24 hours; starting again within that time returns it. 409 when nothing is due.

post.summary: Answer one review exercise
post.description: Re-grades the response (both attempts) on the server and saves it in one transaction. A wrong answer queues the exercise again at the end until it is right; only the first answer counts. Once all of an item's facets in the session are answered, the item moves up a stage if all were right, or down if any was wrong.

get.description: Filters by type, level, stroke count, radical and stage band; `q` searches character, meaning, reading and pattern. Ordered oldest first; cursor paginated.
